discrepancy_categories.SOURCE_ERROR: an error in the wording of a published official text itself
discrepancy_categories.TRANSLATION_DIFFERENCE: the English wording departs from the Arabic (substantive or terminological)
discrepancy_categories.FORMATTING_ANOMALY: list labels or markup differ in a published source; wording corresponds
discrepancy_categories.EXTRACTION_FAILURE: ATTI's extraction does not reproduce the published text
discrepancy_categories.VERSION_MISMATCH: the two texts represent different legal versions

exclusion_rule: Strict corpus: a pair is excluded when the English adds, drops or changes a legal element of the Arabic (negation, condition, threshold, scope, the identity of a sanction, the legal basis) or reflects a different legal version. A pair is retained when only list labels/markup differ with content corresponding one-to-one and in order, or when a term differs but its referent is unambiguous and unchanged. Neither official text is corrected.
